name: Arcane Chtonien
description: Nécromancien ranimant les unités perdues lors des combats pour les faire combattre une dernière fois sous la bannière de l'Éveil.

subject.archetype: Arcane Chtonien — Éveil Chthonien Rare class obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Ancient ceremonial armor fused to wearer's body through dark ritual, shadowy fabric etched with independently shifting runic patterns casting purple light, living shadow tendrils writhing from shoulder guards with own consciousness, armor plates absorbing light instead of reflecting creating void patches with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Massive ritual staff taller than wielder inscribed with independently rotating forbidden symbols, shadow-manipulation artifact orbiting hand like dark satellite with void energy tendrils connecting to body, cursed amulets chained to armor pulsating with green phosphor light emitting foul energy wisps The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting enemy_with_highest, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Frontline combatant engaged directly with enemy forces with weapon fully committed to the attack. Both hands pushed forward with intense focus, focused targeted concentrated nullification beam forming between palms and locking onto highest-value enemy with deadly precision
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Deep Void Purple
palette_names.role: primary_accent — shadow energy emanation and tentacle glow

palette_names.name: Bone White
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — skeletal remains and carved runes

palette_names.name: Eerie Green Phosphor
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — forbidden energy arcs and corruption

color_and_light.lighting_setup: cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols running along each border edge, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground splitting open in massive fissures as enormous shadow tentacles erupt from below, sky showing impossible geometry and wrongness human mind cannot process, ancient runes blazing on every surface as dimensions collapse, reality thinning and tearing at edges, thick oppressive atmosphere of supernatural dread
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Intensely focused beam drilling into target with suppression field building around them as power is systematically dismantled layer by layer, beam unwavering and growing stronger, Ground scorched and vitrified creating glass-like tunnel through battlefield to target, all other targets completely unaffected showing terrifying precision, Massive shadow tentacles erupting from cracked ground grasping at sky, dimensional rifts tearing open revealing impossible non-Euclidean geometry with wrong colors, floating forbidden runes spinning violently in dark purple energy maelstrom, skeletal remains rattling and rising from earth, void essence fog rolling across ground like creeping tsunami
